description_en: Replaces the operating system of an ECS instance by replacing its system disk. After the replacement, the disk ID of the system disk changes and the original disk is released
description_zh: 通过更换ECS实例系统盘的方式更换操作系统。更换后系统盘的云盘ID将发生变化，原云盘会被释放
kebab_example: aliyun ecs replace-system-disk --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --image-id m-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --system-disk-size 80 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --use-additional-service true --password 'EcsV587!' --password-inherit false --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --platform CentOS --architecture i386 --security-enhancement-strategy Active --encrypted false --kms-key-id e522b26d-abf6-4e0d-b5da-04b70000003c --encrypt-algorithm hide --arn AssumeRoleFor=0 RoleType=example-string Rolearn=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReplaceSystemDisk

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target instance.

Make sure that the target instance is in the `Stopped` instance status before you send the request
parameters.help_zh:
指定实例的ID。

发起请求之前请确保目标实例状态为`已停止`（`Stopped`）
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image to use when resetting the system disk. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 重置系统时使用的镜像ID。该参数为必填参数
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The new capacity of the system disk. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

Basic disk: Max{20, image size specified by the ImageId parameter} to 500.
Enterprise SSD:
PL0: Max{1, image size specified by the ImageId parameter} to 2048.
PL1: Max{20, image size specified by the ImageId parameter} to 2048.
PL2: Max{461, image size specified by the ImageId parameter} to 2048.
PL3: Max{1261, image size specified by the ImageId parameter} to 2048.
ESSD AutoPL disk: Max{1, image size specified by the ImageId parameter} to 2048.
Other disk types: Max{20, image size specified by the ImageId parameter} to 2048.

Default value: Max{40, image size specified by the ImageId parameter}.

Disk capacity that exceeds `Max{20, original system disk capacity}` incurs additional charges
parameters.help_zh:
新的系统盘容量，单位为GiB。取值范围：

普通云盘：Max{20, 参数ImageId对应的镜像大小}~500。
ESSD云盘：
PL0：Max{1, 参数 ImageId 对应的镜像大小}~2048。
PL1：Max{20, 参数 ImageId 对应的镜像大小}~2048。
PL2：Max{461, 参数 ImageId 对应的镜像大小}~2048。
PL3：Max{1261, 参数 ImageId 对应的镜像大小}~2048。
ESSD AutoPL 云盘：Max{1, 参数 ImageId 对应的镜像大小}~2048。
其他云盘：Max{20, 参数ImageId对应的镜像大小}~2048。

默认值：Max{40, 参数ImageId对应的镜像大小}。

超过`Max{20, 更换前的系统盘容量}`的云盘容量部分，将收取额外费用
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the virtual machine system configurations provided by Alibaba Cloud (Windows: NTP and KMS. Linux: NTP and YUM).

This parameter takes effect only when the system disk is attached (that is, the device name is /dev/xvda)
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用阿里云提供的虚拟机系统配置（Windows：NTP、KMS；Linux：NTP、YUM）。

挂载系统盘时（即设备名为/dev/xvda）有效
parameters.name: use_additional_service

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to reset the password of the ECS instance. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported:

```
()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
```

For Windows instances, the password cannot start with a forward slash (/).

Default value: The password remains unchanged.

If you specify the `Password` parameter, use HTTPS to send the request to prevent password leaks
parameters.help_zh:
是否重置ECS实例的用户名密码。长度为8至30个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。特殊符号可以是：

```
()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
```

其中，Windows实例不能以斜线号（/）为密码首字符。

默认值：保持不变。

如果传入`Password`参数，建议您使用HTTPS协议发送请求，避免密码泄露
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the preset password of the image.

Default value: false.

If you use this parameter, the Password parameter must be empty. Make sure that the image you use has a preset password
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用镜像预设的密码。

默认值：false。

使用该参数时，Password参数必须为空。同时您需要确保使用的镜像已经设置了密码。
parameters.name: password_inherit

parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair. 

This parameter applies only to Linux ECS instances. You can bind an SSH key pair to an ECS instance as a logon credential. After an SSH key pair is bound, username and password-based logon is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。 

该参数仅对Linux系统ECS实例生效。您可以为ECS实例绑定一个SSH密钥对，作为登录凭证。使用了SSH密钥对后，用户名密码的登录凭证方式将被禁用
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. To improve compatibility, use `ImageId` instead
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，为提高兼容性，建议您使用 `ImageId`
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use Security Center for free after the system disk is replaced. Valid values: 

Active: Uses Security Center. This value is supported only for public images.

Deactive: Does not use Security Center. This value is supported for all images.

Default value: Deactive
parameters.help_zh:
更换系统盘后，是否免费使用云安全中心服务。取值范围： 

Active：使用。该值仅支持公共镜像。

Deactive：不使用。该值支持所有镜像。

默认值：Deactive
parameters.name: security_enhancement_strategy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the disk. Valid values:

true: encrypts the disk.

false: does not encrypt the disk.

Default value: false.

<notice>When you use a shared encrypted image to create a disk based on an encrypted snapshot, you must set the request parameter Encrypted=true for the disk to ensure that the disk uses the key of the account that receives the shared image.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

true：是。

false：否。


默认值：false。

<notice>当使用共享加密镜像，创建基于加密快照的云盘时，必须指定该云盘的请求参数Encrypted=true，以确保创建出的云盘使用的是被共享方自己的密钥。></notice>
parameters.name: encrypted
